ui.printstage.title: Waxyaabaha saxanka printer-kaaga ku habee oo u dir printer-ka
ps.title: Goobta daabacaadda
ps.lab: Cusub build-kan. Daabacaadda hore u fiiri: slicer-kan weli ma lagu tijaabin printer badan.
ps.lib.none: Waxba Maktabadda kuma jiro oo la mid ah.
ps.add.nobody: Walxan ma leh qaab 3D ah oo la daabacayo.
ps.add.done: {name} waa saaran yahay saxanka cabbirka buuxa.
ps.add.scaled: {name} waa saaran yahay saxanka 1:{n} si uu u dhex galo.
ps.stage.empty: Wali waxba halkan ma jiro. Maktabadda ka dar wax, ama soo rog ama soo gali moodeel: wax kasta oo muuqda ayaa la daabacayaa.
ps.stage.move: Waxyaabaha muuqaalka ku guuri, ku leef, oo cabbirkooda ku beddel qalabka caadiga ah. Khadka jajabsan waa saxankaaga.
ps.stage.overlap: Qaar ka mid ah sanduuqyada way is dul saaraan. Taasi waa sax haddii qaababka aysan taabanayn; qaababka taabanaya hal qayb ayay u daabacmaan.
ps.arrange.left: {n} ma habboonayn. Yaree cabbirkooda ama ku daabac socod kale.
ps.engine.cadcraft: CadCraft basic (ku jira, ugu dhakhsaha badan)
ps.link.needs_studio: Printer-kan wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa CadCraft Studio kombiyuutar. Moodeelkan Studio ku fur si aad u dirto.
ps.link.slicer: Printer-kan wuxuu isticmaalaa OrcaSlicer oo leh preset-yadiisa. Agabka, tayada, buuxinta iyo taageerayaasha hoose ayaa weli khuseeya; heerkulka preset-ka ayaa ka imanaya.
ps.engine.need.needs_studio: {name} waa barnaamij u gaar ah, sidaas darteed kombiyuutar ayuu ka shaqeeyaa CadCraft Studio. Halkan slicer kale dooro, ama Studio ku fur.
ps.engine.need.too_old: Nuqulkan {name} aad ayuu u duugan yahay.
ps.field.supports: Hoos u dhaca ku dar taageerayaal
ps.usb.none: Daabacaadda USB waxay u baahan tahay Chrome ama Edge kombiyuutar. Printer shabakad ah halkan ayuu sidoo kale ka shaqeeyaa.
ps.net.note: Printer-ku waa inuu ogolaadaa goobtan. Moonraker-ka, goobtan ku dar cors_domains; OctoPrint-ka, CORS hur oo API key koobiyee. Browser-kaagu wuxuu weydiin karaa inuu aaladaha shabakadaada ku gaari karo: ku jawaab haa.
ps.send.empty: Saxanka waxba kuma jiro oo la daabacayo.
ps.send.off: Marka hore kuwan saxanka ku guuri: {names}.
ps.send.check: Saxanku ma nadiif yahay, agabkana saxda ah ma la rakibay? Printer-ku wuu kulaanayaa oo wuu dhaqdhaqaaqi doonaa.
ps.send.summary: Qiyaas ahaan {time}, {grams} g oo agab ah, {layers} lakab. Nozzle {temp} °C, saxanka {bed} °C.
ps.send.usb_note: USB-ga kuna, bogga hay ilaa daabacaaddu dhamaato. Xiritaankiisu socodka wuu joojinayaa, kululeeyaashana ilaa printer-ku wakhtiga dhammeeyo way shidan yihiin.
ps.send.started: La diray. Printer-ku wuu bilaabayaa: qiyaas ahaan {time}.
ps.send.usb_done: Wax walba waa la diray daabacaaddana way dhammaatay.
ps.send.stopped: Waa la joojiyay. Kululeeyaasha, dabaaldegga iyo motoorada way damaan.
ps.save.done: Waa la kaydiyay: qiyaas ahaan {time}, {grams} g.
ps.warn.skipped_one: Hal qayb ma lahan dhumuc ama lama xirin karo, sidaas darteed way maqnaan doontaa ({share}% qaabka).
ps.warn.skipped: {n} qaybood ma lahan dhumuc ama lama xirin karo, sidaas darteed way maqnaan doonaan ({share}% qaabka).
ps.warn.thin: Ilaa {n}% lakab ayaa khafiif u ah nozzle-kan oo ma daabacmi doono. Weyneeyi, ama qaybahaas dhumuc ku dar.
ps.warn.overhang: Qaybaha qaarkood waxba hoostooda ma yaal. Taageerayaal shid, ama moodeelka u rog si ay sidaas u noqdaan.
ps.warn.floating: Moodeelka saxanka dushiisa ma fadhiyn, sidaas darteed hoos ayaa loo dhaqaajiyay.
ps.slice.empty: Wax la daabici karo ma jiro.
ps.slice.open: Midkoodna qaab xidhan ma aha, sidaas darteed printer-ku wax buuxin karo ma jiro.
ps.slice.bed: Tani saxanka ma habboonayso. Isticmaal Dhammaan saxanka ku habboonee, ama u dhaqaaq gudaha khadka.
ps.fail.unreachable: Printer-ku ma jawaabin. Hubi cinwaanka, inuu goobtan ogolaado, iyo in browser-kaagu shabakadaada ku gaari karo.
ps.fail.busy: Printer-ku wuxuu ku mashquul yahay daabacaad kale.
ps.fail.unsupported: Browser-kan ma isticmaali karo aaladaha USB.
ps.fail.printer: Printer-ku khalad ayuu soo sheegay, sidaas darteed diridu way joogsatay.
